subject: One elegant but CHUNKY IVORY FEATHER, diagonally curved, with a generous broad soft vane and only a SHORT stout warm-tan quill tip. Keep the central vane physically broad enough to survive at 32x32 and the quill very short.

name: 귀인의 검흔 — 벚꽃 초안
subject: A SINGLE LARGE PALE PINK CHERRY BLOSSOM icon, viewed straight on, intended as the blossom motif for a sword relic. EXACTLY FIVE broad rounded petals radiate from one small warm-gold center. One petal up, two to the sides and two down. Each petal has a CLEAR SMALL V-NOTCH at its outer tip, the key identifying CHERRY BLOSSOM feature, large enough to remain perceptible at a tiny logical 32x32. No stem, leaves, branches, detached petals, sword, streaks, lettering, heart shape, four-leaf clover, six petals, sharp star tips or lotus layers. It should be one compact soft five-petaled sakura blossom with a thick rounded charcoal outline, not a geometric flower logo.

name: 네잎클로버 장식 단검
subject: One compact SHORT SILVER DAGGER with a prominent FOUR-LEAF CLOVER ornament integrated into its hilt/pommel. Diagonal composition: broad short double-edged blade points toward the upper area, and a large chunky green clover decorates the lower hilt. The clover must visibly have FOUR rounded heart-like lobes and a simple central join, NOT just a green handle, three leaves, a flower with five petals, or tiny unreadable engraving. Give the clover a substantial 8-10 logical pixel area, and keep the blade broad and short so both dagger and clover are instantly recognizable within 32x32. Silver-white blade plus one blue-gray shadow face, light/dark herbal-green clover, one small solid gold guard/connector. Short thick grip, no wrapping stripes, long thin stem, chain, tassel, blood, runes, sparks or detached clover. A physical lucky dagger relic, no pipe, medicine bottle or background.
